instruction: The deck of a sky pirate airship in flight: a wooden hull slung under a patched balloon, a spoked helm wheel, brass cannons on wheeled mounts, rigging and rope ladders, crates and rum barrels, a fluttering jolly-roger flag, a spyglass on the rail, lanterns swinging, and a sea of sunset clouds drifting past below the hull.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Sky Pirate Airship Deck. The deck of a sky pirate airship in flight: a wooden hull slung under a patched balloon, a spoked helm wheel, brass cannons on wheeled mounts, rigging and rope ladders, crates and rum barrels, a fluttering jolly-roger flag, a spyglass on the rail, lanterns swinging, and a sea of sunset clouds drifting past below the hull. Style: swashbuckling fantasy. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
